before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes parsed trees to its print calls.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
after.reason: The new array print check rejects depth at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT, which array and object parsing already reject. Both print paths start at depth zero.

claims.reason: The same old harness satisfies the frozen array depth obligation on both sides. The focused assessment does not establish coverage of other obligations.
